integrity: Self-contained signed-orbit proof with replayable finite verification. No inference from finite tests to the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced alternating rational character of transposition is determined in all caps; not the full graded character or integral homology. The extremal sphere homotopy type used for the degree corollary is prior work, and an unindexed equivalent character identity may exist. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
